verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a catalog of open-source models (e.g., qwen-3.8-27b on the public tier), but nothing documents how quickly newly released open-weight models reach the platform: no day-zero or launch-timing claims and no community reports of release-to-availability speed. Hosting open models is adjacent to this story, not evidence of fast onboarding.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
